# Kedu

> Kedu is a strict savings AI agent that runs on WhatsApp. Built by Udara Technologies. Funds are held with Rubies Microfinance Bank in Nigeria.

## Product

- Name: Kedu
- Category: WhatsApp savings / personal finance AI agent
- Platform: WhatsApp (no separate app download)
- Company: Udara Technologies
- Banking partner: Rubies Microfinance Bank
- Market: Nigeria
- Privacy: Uses WhatsApp end-to-end encryption; NDPC-certified data protection practices

## What Kedu does

- Helps users see where money goes
- Hard-locks outbound transfers from 7PM until morning
- Supports goal-based saving and accountability
- Instant account block/unblock if a phone is lost or stolen

## Who it is for

People who struggle with overspending, impulse transfers, ADHD-related money habits, emotional spending, or salary burn, and who already live in WhatsApp.
